comments.body: This was fixed in https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/96866 — replaced `getCSNAndAssert` with `getCSN` in `loadDataPart` so that parts from rolled-back transactions with outdated TIDs are correctly treated as rolled back instead of triggering a LOGICAL_ERROR. No recurrences since the fix was merged.

Update: the crash reports added to this issue after the fix (Feb 20–24) are **different bugs** incorrectly grouped here by the bot's similarity scoring. None of them involve `assertTIDIsNotOutdated` or `loadDataPart`:

- Feb 24: `ThreadGroup::createForFlushAsyncInsertQueue` — bug in PR #97302 (WIP branch, not master)
- Feb 22: `doRestartReplica` UUID mismatch — tracked in #97480
- Feb 21: `optimizePrewhere` — unrelated
- Feb 20: Parquet reader — unrelated

The original crash (`Trying to get CSN for too old TID` during `loadDataPart`) has not recurred since PR #96866 was merged.
